puzzle.hint: This verse describes the unseen reward awaiting the righteous in the Hereafter, a joy beyond imagination.
puzzle.arabic: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍۢ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
